events.title: Steam Next Fest is here!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Steam Next Fest is live and the Slots & Skulls demo is part of it, from Oct 19 to Oct 26.If you haven't tried it yet, Slots & Skulls is a turn-based roguelite where your weapon is a slot machine. events.title: Demo Update #10: Gems in 1v1, Ranks, More QoL
events.summary: Hi, This one is mostly about 1v1. You told me the duels were fun but had nothing toshow for them, so now they do. The demo build is 26.10.x. 1. Duel ranks. Every duel you play now counts. After your first three duels youget a rank, from Bronze I up to Obsidian IV, sixteen in all. It comes from yourwhole duel record, so one lucky streak or one bad night does not swing it much,and the higher ranks also ask for a number of wins. Let's get started to list changes briefly.1. PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS is on the menu. You host, you invite a Steam friend through the overlay, they land in your lobby. events.title: Auto 2X Mode, lock shop symbols, poison stack indicator, new modifiers view
events.summary: Hi, Two things carry this update. Your demo save now carries into the full game, and the demo onboarding is better now, it stops handing you every screen at once. The rest is a long economy and polish pass on top of what Update #5 shipped. Let's get started to list changes briefly. 1. Your demo progress carries into the full game. If you buy it, the full version adopts your demo save on first launch, once, and tells you it did. Symbols, forge levels, modifiers, everything you own comes with you.

events.title: Cats, abilities, new modifiers, boxes and more
events.summary: Hi, Enemies drop loot boxes now, a cat can offer you a pact for the whole run, and you get one ability to spend per fight. All of it is in the demo. Let's get started to list changes briefly.1. Kill boxes. Enemies no longer sprinkle loot when they die. Instead a kill has a chance to drop a box, and every box holds exactly one prize, a symbol, gold, skulls or a gem. Boxes come in tiers. events.title: The Demo Is Live
events.summary: Hi, Demo is finally out, of course with limitations but those limitations are not affecting the core gameplay. Three levels, the full slot combat loop, all modifiers, and the Anvil. You'll spin to attack, collect the symbols that drop, and decide how much of your build you're willing to gamble on an upgrade. A run would take about an hour. events.title: A Note on Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Slots and Skulls hasn't gone through Steam's official Steam Deck compatibility review yet, so the rating shows as "Unknown" and you won't see an automatic badge on the store page.
